findings.issue: Chart-type hints use identifiers not accepted by the installed Flint runtime.
findings.reproduction: Both live chart-brief cases returned suggested chartType stacked_bar_chart. Flint validate_chart rejected it with Unknown chart type: stacked_bar_chart; Stacked Bar Chart with normalize validated.
findings.scope: The framing-to-renderer handoff needs explicit normalization. Full render-chart orchestration was not live-tested, so this is not a claim that every end-to-end rendering fails.

harnessTriage.initialMechanicalChecks: All twelve matched the initial lightweight checks. Semantic review narrowed that result; those regex checks were insufficient to certify chart validity.
harnessTriage.noWriteInterpretation: All fixture workspaces retained identical file hashes. Native Plan mode permits private plan/session files, which were created in disposable state and removed. This is not standalone proof that each skill enforces permissions without the host.
harnessTriage.standaloneVersusActivated: The first twelve cases mounted the installed plugin but did not copy its resident instructions into their disposable profiles. The chart retest activated all fifteen and demonstrated SQL fallback; normal user activation was not changed.
